description: Buttons join into one strip, and a single highlight glides from segment to segment under the pointer or keyboard focus, taking each segment's corners as it goes.
moves: One highlight springs from segment to segment instead of each button lighting up on its own.
The highlight appears where it lands the first time and fades out where it was when the pointer leaves.
A segment sinks a little and springs back, less than a lone button so the strip stays joined.
A separator grows in from its centre.
keyboard: Moves to the next control in the group; each one is its own tab stop.

propDocs.ButtonGroup.orientation: Lays the buttons out in a row (`"horizontal"`, the default) or a column (`"vertical"`).
propDocs.ButtonGroupSeparator.orientation: Which way the line runs. Vertical by default, for a group laid out in a row.
propDocs.ButtonGroupSeparator.decorative: Hides the line from assistive technology. On by default: it only joins two halves of one key.
